competitive_summary.market_opportunity: The Canadian luxury/fashion market has near-zero AI readiness. No brand has Product schema, no brand has bilingual schema, and only one has llms.txt. This is a greenfield opportunity for VisiMind — the first mover advantage is enormous. Any brand that adds proper structured data + AI discovery will dominate rich results and AI recommendations in this vertical.

tier_1_immediate.reason: Shopify stores with zero or minimal schema, easy to implement, high ROI. Moose Knuckles is the most urgent — luxury brand with nothing.

tier_2_strategic.reason: ALDO has good foundation to build on. Rudsak needs JSON-LD to complement their llms.txt. Canada Goose is high-value enterprise deal.

tier_3_complex.reason: Custom platforms with bot-blocking. Require strategic approach — likely need C-level buy-in to change AI access policies. Highest contract value but longest sales cycle.
